page.notes: Run-in lemmas (Quod quaerendum est., Redeatq; mortuo., Nihil refert.) are set in italic at paragraph starts within the text column and are transcribed in place. "quae stioni" is printed with a space at the line end, left as printed. "Offic." is written whole, its printed line-end break ("Of fic.") is not a hyphen. A stray dark mark at the left edge beside the second paragraph is not printed text and is omitted. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout. Running head ornaments are omitted, as they contain no words.
